firstPlayerRule: The person who was most recently on a mountain starts.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns proceed clockwise.
Each later player receives a Rock tile based on player count and order, then places it on their first turn alongside their Meadow tile.

sources.title: Spring Meadow — English rulebook

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the Stronghold Games English rulebook from a retailer mirror. Printed page 4 identifies the most recent mountain visitor as start player and sets later players’ initial Rock tiles; page 7 confirms clockwise play. The hiking map, signpost and meadow/rock tiles match inventory BGG 253684. A secondary review incorrectly claims a random starter, so the publisher-authored PDF governs this entry.
